item.title: PORCELAIN MASTERCLASS
item.description:
Sat 12 Sep, 9:00 AM – Sun 13 Sep · Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre · $375 (inc gst)
Make beautiful translucent porcelain vases with a colourful surface design with contemporary ceramic artist Tania Vrancic. Explore your own creativity through mono-printing, stenciling, and painting with colourful porcelain using slip-casting methods. Hand-build vases, jewellery, and Christmas ornaments with your slabs. Enjoy this intuitive process to free your imagination. You will learn how to best prepare your work for firing and how to polish the surfaces after firing.

item.title: Briscoe Sisters
item.description:
Sun 13 Sep, 6:00 PM · Maleny Community Centre · See link
Hailing from Yalanji country in Far North QLD, Briscoe Sisters have been performing their songs and cultural stories for over two decades. From their early days being recognised as Port Fairy’s Folk Festival’s Matons Young Talent of the year in 2005 and top 4 Deadly’s new talent in 2004, the sisters Deline, Merindi and Naurita spent 10 years touring to national major events and Festivals across Australia. Highlights inclue performing at CIAF 2018, Tandanya Spirit Festival in South Australia and performing alongside Yothu Yindi Band at the Yarrabah Music Festival in 2018. With recent performances at Woodford Folk Festival and at The Sydney Opera House, Briscoe Sisters are back on tour and performing select Festivals across Australia bringing Kuku Yalanji language and song to audiences once again. Deline, Merindi and Naurita’s sister harmonies, trained in gospel singing from their youth, makes for an incredibe live show. Grounded in their culture and families, these sisters continue to bring great healing and empowerment through their music.

item.title: Cirque Le Strange
item.description:
Sat 19 Sep, 7:00 PM · Kings Beach Tavern, Caloundra · Caloundra + Kawana · See link
Roll up, roll up! The punk circus of your craziest dreams is coming to town. Live and direct from the underground party scene comes Cirque Le Strange by Oozing Future. This unforgettable collection of carnies and queers has to be seen to believed! Featuring surreal and unusual acts that test the limits of the human body, this show is like nothing you’ve ever seen before. Meet the King of the Freaks – world-famous body modification star The Lizardman, as seen on Ripley’s Believe it or Not! See the bendiest woman in the southern hemisphere, queen of contortion Soliana Ersie! Catch punk clown Captain Ruin creating mischief and mayhem, before hanging weights off his private parts! See gender-bending draglesque creature Winter Greene, winner of Mx Burlesque Victoria 2025! And watch in awe as pole dancing siren Thembot entrances you with erotic skill and strength. All this and more is ready to hit the road and explode on stage in a town near you. With ten stops on our first national tour, this is your chance to join the freaks for a truly surreal night out at the punk circus!

item.title: OLD HOME 2026 + FRIENDS
item.description:
Fri 11 Sep, 6:00 PM · The Presynct Venue & Bar, Nambour · See link
OLD HOME 2026 + FRIENDS Old Home wake up. Never die. A night of raw guitars, brooding melodies and fearless songwriting, OLD HOME 2026 + FRIENDS brings together four artists pushing alternative music in their own direction. Headlining the night is Old Home, blending the urgency of post-punk with spoken-word intensity. Imagine the restless energy of Fugazi colliding with the haunting atmosphere of The Cure - powerful, poetic and impossible to ignore. Joining them are Local Authority, delivering shimmering shoegaze and dream-pop textures that drift between lush soundscapes and driving rhythms, sitting somewhere between The Cure and Slowdive. Jack Dylan and the Villains bring an alt-country rock 'n' roll edge, fusing gritty storytelling with expansive guitar work that fans of Dire Straits and The Drones will appreciate. Opening the evening is Connor Mitchell, whose stripped-back songwriting draws from the dark Australian grit of The Drones and the timeless folk spirit of Townes Van Zandt. If you love post-punk, shoegaze, alternative rock, dream pop or alt-country, this is a lineup built for discovering your next favourite band. item.title: Rob McWilliams Band at The Jazz Sessions
item.description:
Thu 17 Sep, 6:00 PM · The Presynct Venue & Bar, Nambour · See link
Rob McWilliams Band Professor Rob McWilliams has led an interesting life. A musician and composer, playing trumpet, flugelhorn and piano, he has been part of the jazz scene for many years, originally playing professionally in Melbourne with artists such as Wilbur Wilde and Paul Grabowsky. His studies and high level of musicianship led him to the USA where he took up the post of Professor of Music at the University of Wisconsin, Oshkosh and ended up as Head of Music there for several years. As a teacher he has presented at major music conferences in Japan, Hong Kong, the UK, Singapore, Europe, China and Australia and is a published author. As a musician he has performed with many jazz greats including Nat Adderley, Vincent Herring, Dee Dee Bridgewater, Eddie Daniels, Ed Shaughnessy and Dale Barlow – a resume that is the envy of many an Australian jazz musician! A talented musician, composer and arranger, Rob has had many opportunities over the years to create and perform his music to audiences all over the world. Now living back in Australia, he works for Yamaha Music conducting music workshops around Australia as well as teaching at the Jazz Music Institute in Brisbane, conducting, composing, arranging music and performing regularly around Australia either as a side man or with his own jazz ensemble. Though he is a Professor with an incredible and impressive Curriculum Vitae, he is a warm and down-to-earth performer with a genuine connection to the audience, bringing the music alive. This masterful musician in now bringing his music to the Sunshine Coast, performing with his band at The Jazz Sessions at The Presynct on Thurs 17th Sep. Joined on this gig by a stellar line-up of local Brisbane & Sunshine Coast musicians, they have come together to perform unique interpretations of jazz standards and some of Rob’s original compositions. Be prepared for an evening of sophistication, smooth jazz and world-class musicianship. VENUE & EVENT DETAILS 📅 Thursday 17th September 📍The Presynct, Upstairs- 15 Ann St, Nambour ⏰ Doors 6:00pm | Event 6:30pm -9:00pm 🚗 Parking available behind the Venue 🎟 Tickets $25-$45 🩴 NO Thongs Permitted 🚱 NO Outside Drink bottles If you’re looking for a unique concert experience, look no further than The Jazz Sessions at The Presynct. This hidden gem offers intimate shows for listeners in a beautifully curated venue. These are listening concerts where people can come together to enjoy live music in a true jazz club experience. We ask that talking is kept to a quiet whisper as audience members are actively listening to and connecting with the artists in a relaxed and comfortable setting. These concerts give guests the opportunity to experience exceptional musicianship in an intimate setting.

item.title: Body Type
item.description:
Sat 19 Sep, 7:00 PM · Mapleton Public House, Mapleton · Nambour + Hinterland · See link
Over the past decade, Body Type have established themselves as one of Australia’s most acclaimed and compelling bands. Since forming in Sydney in 2016, they have released two celebrated albums, earned an Australian Music Prize nomination, toured extensively throughout Australia, Europe and the UK, and shared stages with Foo Fighters, Fontaines D.C., Pixies, Big Thief, Warpaint, Sleater-Kinney and Cate Le Bon. Now, the four-piece return with Tally, their third album and most ambitious work to date. Marking the band’s tenth anniversary, Tally captures a group taking stock, embracing change and pushing their sound into bold new territory while retaining the wit, charm and sharp observations that have become their trademark. Recorded in Los Angeles with acclaimed producer Stella Mozgawa (Warpaint, Courtney Barnett), Tally draws inspiration from a wide range of sources: the work of artist Louise Bourgeois, misty drives through the Hollywood Hills, 10 years of history as a band. The album transforms the everyday into something surreal, witty and profound while exploring love, friendship, insecurity and the strange beauty hidden within ordinary life.

item.title: Disgraceland
item.description:
Fri 18 Sep, 7:30 PM · Kings Beach Tavern, Caloundra · Caloundra + Kawana · See link
Disgraceland | Live at Kings Beach Tavern Friday 18 September 🎸🔥 Australia, brace yourself. Disgraceland are about to Wipeout the country one pub at a time and they are rolling into Kings Beach for a night that will feel like a greatest-hits party you never want to end. With a new single dropping, a tour already gaining serious momentum, and crowds packing out shows across the country, this is quickly shaping up as their biggest run yet. They have been sharing stages with Aussie rock icons like Rose Tattoo and Baby Animals, and the word is well and truly out. So what’s the deal? Punked-up, high-energy versions of every song you ever loved. The kind of set where you go from “I know this one” to “how am I already yelling the chorus” in about 10 seconds 🤘😄 Expect: Non-stop singalongs and dancefloor chaos (the fun kind) A packed pub vibe with huge energy from the first song A setlist full of familiar bangers, recharged and turned up If you’ve seen Disgraceland before, you already know what’s coming. If you haven’t, this is your chance to fix that. Tickets are moving fast for this one. Get in early and don’t be the person hearing about it the next day 🎟️🍻

item.title: NINO BROWN – 90s RNB + Urban Night
item.description:
Sat 12 Sep, 9:00 PM · Kings Beach Tavern, Caloundra · Caloundra + Kawana · See link
NINO BROWN – 90s RNB + URBAN NIGHT Australia’s No.1 Urban DJ Nino Brown is bringing a massive 90s RNB, hip hop and urban club night to Queensland this September. A true Australian urban music institution, Nino Brown has performed across Australia and South East Asia, sharing stages with some of the biggest names in the world including Eminem, Jay-Z, Snoop Dogg, Rihanna, Busta Rhymes, Akon, Nelly, T-Pain and Sean Paul. Best known for his iconic Blazin’ mixtape series with Universal Music — which became one of the country’s biggest urban music compilations, selling over 500,000 copies — Nino has helped shape Australian RNB, hip hop and urban club culture for decades. Expect a full night of 90s RNB classics, old-school hip hop, throwback party anthems and urban club favourites, delivered by one of the most recognised and respected DJs in the country. Saturday 12 September – Kings Beach Tavern, Caloundra Round up the crew. This is a proper throwback RNB night.

Sunshine Coast Animal Refuge proudly presents “Open Day” We will have lots of fun activities and education for families* who want to support rescue cats and dogs and learn how to welcome a new pet into their home. Come and enjoy kids’ activities, education and demonstrations, guided tours of the Shelter, a Doggy Kissing Booth, a charity sausage sizzle, and a coffee van. The SCARS Market will also be open for a special day of sales. ‍As part of the Open Day we will be running our silly Dog Plop Jackpot. Purchase a ticket for a square of land in our dog yard and if one of our rescue dogs plops on your land you will win the jackpot – 20% of the ticket sales. Help us sell all 100 squares of land to raise vital funds for our rescue cats and dogs and make the jackpot reach $10,000!! Purchase your Dog Plop Jackpot ticket here: https://rafflelink.com/r/scars/dogplop26 ‍* We look forward to welcoming visitors of all ages, but please note that this will not be an event for family pets to attend. They will be invited back for Santa Paws later this year.
